svg.aria-label: Deer and bear near Mission. Strategy is opinion. Black tailed deer, bucks, to 15 December: Where Cutblock edges, old roads, salal and alder. Old growth higher up in winter (90%). When The rut: November into early December (80%). Late season is your best window (Tip). How Still hunt slowly, short shots, not long glassing (Tip). Black bear, to 30 November: Where Fall berry patches, Himalayan blackberry on valley edges, young cutblocks (90%). How Glass berry slopes in the evening (Tip).
svg.text: Strategy is opinion. Each line says Tip or gives its source.
